title: Integrate Task Outcome generation validation rendering and Cockpit link into ai-finish
rawUserRequest: Implement the Task Outcome ai-finish integration from the execution plan: enforce Final Verification, Summary generation/validation, Outcome generation/validation, Markdown derivation, Cockpit Status generation, and a short Outcome link/count summary in the correct order. Preserve raw Evidence on failure and fail closed. Execute serially through this Work Item PR and closure.

declaredIntent.summary: Integrate Task Outcome generation, validation, rendering, and Cockpit link presentation into ai-finish.

outOfScope: Generator, validator, standalone renderer, archive lifecycle, PR summary, multilingual, documentation, release publication, and historical evidence changes.

sources.reason: Plan Extension defines ai-finish order and failure preservation.
Existing final verification and archive orchestration boundary.

riskAssessment.reason: ai-finish is a governance-critical orchestration boundary; order and raw-evidence preservation must remain fail closed.

executionDecision.reason: Integration scope, order, failure behavior, evidence sources, and serial authorization are explicit.

preReviewWarnings: Review the strict finish ordering and verify that Cockpit Status contains only Outcome link/count metadata.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: ai-finish runs final verification, Summary generation/validation, Outcome generation/validation, Markdown derivation, Cockpit Status, and presentation in the declared order.
Outcome validation failure preserves raw Evidence, prevents success/archival claims, and reports a structured failure.
Cockpit Status remains short and includes only an Outcome link/count summary; full Outcome content is not copied into status.
Focused tests cover ordering, command failure, raw-evidence preservation, link/count summary, and no duplicate state transitions.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: Successful finish executes all Outcome steps in order and records a short Cockpit link/count summary.
Generator or validator failure stops finish and preserves raw Evidence.
Status output does not copy the full report or manufacture scores.
Existing finish/archive behavior remains compatible when Outcome integration is disabled or no evidence is present.

guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: The Task Outcome artifacts exist but are not yet part of the governed finish path, so later integrations could archive or present a task without validated Outcome evidence.
constraints: Keep final verification first and fail closed on Outcome generation/validation errors.
Preserve raw Evidence and existing ai-finish lifecycle semantics.
Keep Cockpit Status concise and link to Outcome rather than copying it.
intent.rationale: Integrating at the existing finish orchestration boundary gives one auditable order and prevents later presentation or archive steps from bypassing validation.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized completion of the serial plan, including required governance entrypoint changes.
